target: labellum lobe (FLOPO_0986028), part of orchid labellum (FLOPO_0980978), the middle lobe of the series (lateral lobes vs mid-lobe), recorded as the position of the bearer (pattern 04)
reason: Narrower: the middle lobe of a three-lobed orchid lip. It is a position within an existing class, labellum lobe, so no new class is needed. PATO has no 'median' position quality. The cue 'median' stays in the record until a position term exists.
Exact in sense: the 'articles' of a breaking-up grass rachis (Andropogoneae and others) are the internodes of the inflorescence axis, described as linear, clavate, ciliate.
A generic part: 'fringe' can belong to a corona, a petal, a lip or a trap, and the examples don't name it. It needs the organ, like 'segment' and 'appendage' in the previous review.

target: stalk (PO_0025066) part of portion of secretory tissue (PO_0005656) (gland, rule C265), pattern 12
reason: The stalk that carries a stalked gland. 'gland' already grounds to portion of secretory tissue (C265), and the stalk is expressed as part of it. If the flora means glandular hairs, the whole is glandular trichome (PO_0004509).
OCR error for the micron sign 'µ' in measurements ('27-60 µ'). It is a unit, not a structure, and the statements belong to algae (oospore, vegetative cell).
A piece of a fungal or lichen count, 'spores 8/ascus'. It is a count per container, and an ascus is outside PO and FLOPO.

label: nodal diaphragm
parent: is_a cardinal organ part (PO_0025001); part_of stem node (PO_0020141)
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is a transverse plate of tissue spanning the cavity of a hollow shoot axis at a stem node (PO:0020141), separating the hollow internodes, as in bamboos, Equisetum and many aquatic plants.
reason: A real structure that floras measure (thickness), and the thickness of the diaphragm is not the thickness of the node. PO has no class for it. Propose upstream to PO. Seen in one flora here, but standard in bamboo and Equisetum treatments.
Narrower: the flat disc formed by the united stigmas in Nuphar and Nymphaea (Nymphaeaceae, entire to crenate, green or reddened). It is the stigma of the syncarpous gynoecium.
A fragment of a ratio to another part, '1.5-2 × as long as perianth segments' (pattern 10). The part is perianth segment, and the '×' was taken into the name.

target: flower (PO_0009046) (floret, rule C261) in the inner position of the capitulum, as a state of the bearer (pattern 04); disk flower (PO_0025332) when the head is radiate
reason: A position in the head. In disciform heads (e.g. Gnaphalieae) the inner florets are not the counterpart of rays, so mapping them straight to disk flower would be wrong in some taxa.

label: anther tube
parent: is_a collective organ part structure (PO_0025269); part_of androecium (PO_0009061)
definition: A collective organ part structure (PO:0025269) composed of the connate anthers (PO:0009066) of two or more stamens of an androecium (PO:0009061), forming a tube around the style, as in Asteraceae and Lobelioideae.
reason: No existing class fits. Staminal tube (FLOPO_0986013) is the fused filaments. Synandrium (FLOPO_0986014) is whole stamens fused, but in Asteraceae the filaments stay free. Used by many floras for Asteraceae and Campanulaceae. Propose upstream to PO next to the corolla tube request.
Exact: staminal tube is defined as the fused filaments of the stamens.
OCR error for 'µ' (micron) in algal measurements ('12 by 10-18 µ'). It is a unit.

target: bract (PO_0009055) part of peduncle (PO_0009053) (scape, rule C255), pattern 12
reason: Narrower: the sterile bracts on the scape (Bromeliaceae: lepidote, densely imbricate). It is a bract qualified by the whole that bears it.

label: syconium
definition: An inflorescence (PO:0009049) in which numerous small flowers line the inner surface of a hollow, fleshy, urn-shaped receptacle that opens by a small apical pore (ostiole), as in Ficus; in fruit it develops into a multiple fruit (the fig).
reason: A real structure that every flora treating Ficus uses ('syconia 1-3 in leaf axils'). PO has no class: the term only appears as a broadMatch to fruit, which misses the flowering stage. A proposal key FLOPO_LOCAL:syconium with evidence EVID:NYBG_SYCONIUM already exists but has no FLOPO id. Propose upstream to PO.

A generic pit or depression ('rim fringed all around'). It can be the nectary pit of a tepal (Calochortus, Fritillaria) or the sporangial pit of an Isoetes leaf. It needs the organ, like 'pit' in the previous review.

target: count of spine leaf (PO_0025173) part of areole bud (PO_0025353), pattern 03 with pattern 12
reason: A count of spines within a whole. The cactus areole is PO's areole bud, whose leaves develop as spine leaves.
Narrower: a raceme that is a branch (partial inflorescence) of a compound raceme. Being a raceme is what floras state about it.

'Aristule' is a small awn, but PO awn (PO_0025349) is defined for grass glumes, lemmas and paleae only. The values (retrorsely barbed, antrorse) suggest pappus awns of Bidens-like Asteraceae, which are pappus element (PO_0025394). It is ambiguous without the organ.
Narrower: the beak of a fruit formed by the persistent style (flattened, truncate, erect). Unlike the bare 'beak', this name says which organ it is.
A quality, decussate (PATO_0001953), describing pairs of leaves or flowers ('1-5 decussate pairs'). The counted part is the pair.
Narrower: the stalk of a partial inflorescence (paraclade) of a compound inflorescence. PO lists paraclade and inflorescence branch as synonyms of higher order inflorescence axis.

label: anther theca appendage
parent: is_a cardinal organ part (PO_0025001); part_of anther theca (PO_0009069)
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is a spur-, tail- or tooth-like outgrowth at the base or apex of an anther theca (PO:0009069), as in many Acanthaceae.
reason: A real structure and a key character in Acanthaceae (Justicia and relatives) across tropical floras. Its shape and presence are recorded. PO has no class, and the generic 'appendage' was rejected. Propose upstream to PO.
A substance (Tannins: present), not a plant part.
Narrower: PO staminate flower includes a gynoecium that 'has aborted during development', which covers florets with a sterile ovary. 'Functionally' stays as a cue.
A generic part. 'Segment' was rejected as needing its organ, and 'basal' only adds a position in a series of unknown parts (leaf segments, perianth segments, pinnae).

target: flower (PO_0009046) (floret, rule C261) with female (PATO_0000383, rule C232) and marginal (FLOPO:0991208) as states of the bearer (pattern 04)
reason: A truncation of 'marginal female florets'. The outer female florets of disciform heads are not always rays, so ray flower would be too narrow.

Both words are generic parts that the previous review rejected ('scale', 'acumen'). These are probably fern rhizome scales, but a scale can also be a bract, bud scale or cone scale. It needs the organ.
Narrower or near-exact: in Asteraceae the tubular florets are the disc florets of the head, as opposed to the ligulate or ray florets.
A wrong singular of 'species' ('Plus de 100 espèces'). It is a count of taxa in a genus, not a plant part.
